label: Box K node projected from the NECESSARY_2 classical GOD_4 root
description: Assembly (a weakening, not a substantive derivation): the classical GOD_4 root projects onto the box K node of the sense fork for the same signature, Profile and world, using necessaryAt_iff_boxExistsAt (Iff.rfl). It gives the box K node a closure path from every derivation of STMT-NECESSARY-CLASSICAL-GOD-ROOT (including its Dei Filius, underived-individual, act-priority-at-first, pure-act-by-composition, positive-root and asymmetry routes). As an assembly it closes the node only by rule (d), if its premise is closed. On the current corpus its premise is closed by rule (a), proved from open premises but not established, and the box K node was already closed by rule (a) through other derivations, so the assembly adds no closure; it never expands the box K node in the route-cost diagnostic, and every upstream premise keeps its status. A verified non-transcription derivation of the box K node from the same 25 quarta-via inputs already exists (argument a693bf86).
